newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bremen coffee prices ease in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Bremen coffee prices ease in slow trade.

text.p: Arabica coffee prices in the Bremen physical market shed $3 per 50 kg fob on the week in line with futures reductions, traders said on Friday.

Trading was subdued and ample Brazilian offers for September through December did not attract much interest as consumers were mostly covered. The prospect of Monday's future market closure due to a U.S. holiday also discouraged activity.
Centralamerican differentials narrowed as early new crop offers emerged.
Indonesian and Vietnamese robusta sellers were keen to place material. Buyers ignored spot offers but showed some interest for shipment dates after January 1997.
